summary: SOBR Safe, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 2, 2026, furnishing a press release clarifying third-party news and postponing its 2026 Annual Meeting. The filing discloses that Nasdaq determined on September 14, 2026 to delist the company's common stock, with trading suspended September 16, 2026; shares now trade on OTC Pink Limited under 'SOBR.' The board had set November 2, 2026 as the annual meeting date but postponed it indefinitely. The company says it is exploring options taking no decision yet. The development increases uncertainty around the registrant's listing status and shareholder process.
